- desk/STATE.json still stamped 2026-09-11T04:50Z — thirty-eight days stale. T-2026-09-11-001 still `open_waiting_nova`, thirty-seventh cycle after this seat ruled it expired flat. Book unchanged: HL perps FLAT, ~$18.17 HL spot + $10.33 SOL book. Mandate caps intact. Alex: the L1 clock workflow paste remains the one human action owed.

## 2. Overnight world read (verified outside the bus)
**CRYPTO — the revision coin-flip runs UP a second day; the probe sequence pauses.** SOL: Oct-18 REVISED UP to 104.02 (provisional was 103.83) — and the day's low revised DEEPER, 100.51 vs 100.64 printed. Oct-19 (provisional): C 104.97 (+0.91% d/d), O 104.02 / H 105.88 / L 103.64 — the FIRST session since Oct-14 with NO intraday probe below $103 (sequence had run 101.03 / 102.65 / 101.43 / 100.51r). Seventh consecutive close below 105.84 counting the Oct-13 revised 105.56 (sixth from Oct-14). The $103 hard falsifier holds; the closes-contract is intact; today the auction took a day off. BTC: Oct-18 REVISED UP +315.66 to 82,017.60 — second consecutive upward revision since the eight-down streak broke (coin-flip now 2/2 up). Oct-19 provisional: C 81,954.55 (-0.08% vs revised), H 83,014.36 / L 81,706.25; 31st confirmed / 32nd provisional session above 78,900. ETH: Oct-18 revised up to 2,408.74; Oct-19 provisional 2,404.25 (-0.19%). ETF flows: Farside Oct-19 row PARTIAL at filing — GBTC -54.9M printed, IBIT/FBTC and five others blank; October MTD ~-$669.6M and will move when the row completes. The post-CPI bleed continues but at a slower drip than last week's -484.9/-244.1 pair.

**OIL — fired leg day 9: Monday's thin row holds inside the Sunday range.** BZ=F Oct-19 row (vol 66 — pre-full-session thin): O 109.13 / H 109.33 / L 109.07 / forming 109.28 — inside Sunday's 108.75–110.25 range, +4.56 over the 104.72 firing settle; the leg holds. The discriminating test set last cycle (first FULL session vs the Sunday range) does not adjudicate on a 66-lot row — full settle prints tomorrow. CL=F forming 98.22 (unchanged from Sunday's forming; -3.2% vs the revised 101.41 settle). GC=F forming 4,155.60 (-0.6%). Volume artifacts: BZ=F dup persists on Oct-15/16 (54,248 both — fifteenth artifact cycle); CL=F dup 222,965; GC=F dup 159,510. The IRGC mine claim now has a second carrier: WANA (Oct-19) relays the IRGC Navy PR statement — a 'non-compliant' tanker transiting dark (AIS off) on the unauthorized southern route struck a sea mine south of Hormuz, engine-room explosion and fire; the IRGC warns dark transits face a 'firm and decisive response.' Still no UKMTO incident number attached at filing — claimed-vs-confirmed gap stands.

**FED — December bleeds again; the Kalshi internal gap REOPENED.** DeFi Rate relay (Kalshi/Polymarket aggregate, observed Oct-19 6:36–7:07pm ET): October hike ~14-15% / hold 85-86% / cut ~2% (7-day move: hike 18->14). December-9 hike 76% on the two-venue average, Kalshi-only meeting path 80% — down from 77% Sunday; last Thursday's CME 89% stands as the comparison print because Monday's CME read was NOT retrievable this cycle — the venue-spread adjudication (artifact vs drift) CARRIES to tomorrow. Kalshi's same-exchange disagreement REOPENED: decision market 13.5% vs rate-level 15.5% — the gap closed to 1pt Sunday has re-widened to 2pts inside 24h; 'closes quickly' is now 0-for-2 on persistence. Kalshi 82.5% vs Polymarket 80.5% on a 2026 hike. Blackout runs to Oct 27-28; September PCE Oct-29. ^TNX Oct-19 closed 5.136 (from 5.098) — cushion to the 5.00 fail level now 13.6bp.

**RIYADH — 50 hours past deadline, silence.** The NOTAM (A3604/26) expired 2100 GMT Oct-17; GACA has announced no reopen-or-extend (SafeAirspace Level 1 Do-Not-Fly stands; US Mission Saudi alert restricts staff airport use). No post-deadline Houthi claim surfaced in this sweep — the tell remains untripped at +50h. HORMUZ: no new UKMTO-numbered incident beyond the mine-claim carrier above.

**ALPENGLOW T-1 — the structural break now has a size.** Activation Wed Oct-21 ~14:50 UTC (epoch 1064; solana.com puts epoch start ~13:20 UTC; QuickNode maintenance window 14:50–17:50 UTC). Anza (Oct-16) names Agave v4.3.2 the recommended release (v4.3.0 base); Firedancer/Frankendancer operators must switch clients temporarily; each vote account needs 0.8 SOL over rent-exempt for the new per-epoch Validator Admission Ticket. Migration sequence: TowerBFT continues ~the first 5,000 slots (~18 min), blocks temporarily stop carrying user transactions, Alpenglow genesis certificate forms at 82% stake, consensus hands to Votor. FOR THE SIGNAL PIPELINE: the vote-transaction share is now sized — one source puts vote txs at 63% of total activity; another at ~75% of block space with 'nominal TPS' dropping 70-75% to a 'true TPS' of 600-800. Post-switch, SOL on-chain transaction-count series will print a mechanical drop of roughly two-thirds that is NOT reduced user activity. Any on-chain activity signal MUST be re-based at epoch 1064 or it will false-positive a demand collapse Wednesday afternoon. Firedancer's bug bounty (2x rewards, 3x for Alpenglow finds, runs to Nov-20) is the security tail-watch.

**Data-path check:** Binance 32nd check — DISCONNECTED for the second consecutive cycle: (BTCUSDT,SOLUSDT,ETHUSDT) returned EMPTY_DATA, all symbol queries failed. Paper-tape-survives-451 clause in play; Yahoo complex is the tape of record — single-source dependence noted for the second straight cycle. Kalshi direct still blocked, eleventh cycle; DeFi Rate relay substituted.

## 3. Interrogation notes
- No new thesis on the bus to interrogate, thirty-seventh cycle. Nova CONCUR/VETO queue unchanged (argus_002, argus_003, T-2026-09-11-001 post-hoc, orbital_001) — fortieth cycle on the oldest. Idle-task per PROMPT_FOR_ARGUS: nothing new unfalsified from orbital or nova since Sep-11; the standing unfalsified set is the queue above.
- Self-interrogation, scored: (1) **THE UP-REVISION PATTERN IS RUNNING** — last cycle's new working rule (provisional closes on violent down-legs biased conservative) is now 3-for-3: SOL 103.83p->104.02r, BTC 81,701.94p->82,017.60r, ETH 2,392.69p->2,408.74r. Two consecutive up-revisions on BTC since the streak broke is not yet a run — but 'unpatterned' now leans up-biased; a third up-revision tomorrow re-establishes a directional streak in the opposite direction. (2) **THE AUCTION PAUSED, IT DID NOT RESOLVE** — four deepening probes then a clean day. One session without a probe is not exoneration; the closes-contract still decides, and six-to-seven consecutive closes under 105.84 with zero revised closes under 103 keeps the contradiction alive. Watch whether the probe sequence resumes — a fifth probe under 103 after a one-day pause reads as continued auction; three clean sessions reads as defense. (3) **THE KALSHI GAP IS A REPEATER** — closed to 1pt Sunday, reopened to 2pts Monday. The 'closes quickly' prior is wrong on persistence even when right on direction; treat the internal spread as a noise band (1-4pts) rather than a convergence trade. (4) **DECEMBER BLEEDS BUT THE REFERENCE IS STALE** — relay 77->76, Kalshi-path 80, CME stuck at Thursday's 89 until a fresh print is retrievable. The drift-vs-artifact call cannot adjudicate without the CME side; carrying with a bias toward drift (the relay side keeps stepping down while the futures side is unobserved). (5) **ALPENGLOW IS A PIPELINE EVENT, NOT A PRICE EVENT** — with the vote-tx share sized at 63-75%, an unrebased activity signal would read a mechanical ~2/3 collapse as a demand crash. Re-basing at epoch 1064 is the single most important ops action of this watch week; the migration's ~18-minute user-transaction blackout is a second, smaller artifact window.
- External calibration: SOL revised 104.02 vs provisional 103.83 (+0.19%); BTC revised 82,017.60 vs provisional 81,701.94 (+0.39%); ETH revised 2,408.74 vs 2,392.69p (+0.67%). DeFi Rate observation window Oct-19 6:36–7:07pm ET — fresh. Binance unavailable for cross-check, second cycle.

4. Hormuz throughput FOUR-way unchanged (PortWatch 2 transits vs TE 11.62M b/d vs TT '>100M bbl last week' vs US '97% transit safely' + UKMTO 135-ledger); IRGC mine claim now carried by ISNA AND the IRGC Navy PR via WANA — still no UKMTO number.

8. December venue spread UNADJUDICATED: relay 76% / Kalshi-path 80% vs CME 89% (stale, Thursday) — Monday CME print not retrievable; carries.
9. Binance 32nd check: DISCONNECTED, second consecutive full failure (EMPTY_DATA all symbols).
10. Black Sea shipping silence — eighth week plus.
11. Tehran reply to the reopening proposal STILL inbound — beyond three weeks; pre-committed trigger NOT fired.
12. ^TNX Oct-12 flat 5.24 zero-volume row — Columbus Day carry artifact (carried).
13. Riyadh NOTAM: +50h past the 2100 GMT Oct-17 deadline; GACA silent; reopen-or-extend unconfirmed; no post-deadline Houthi claim.
14. Alpenglow structural break T-1: vote-tx share sized 63% of activity / ~75% of block space; unrebased on-chain signals false-fire Wednesday ~14:50 UTC; ~18-min user-tx blackout during handoff.
15. NEW: Farside Oct-19 row partial (-54.9M with IBIT/FBTC blank) — MTD ~-$669.6M is a floor pending row completion.
16. NEW: Alpenglow clock disagreement — epoch start ~13:20 UTC (solana.com) vs activation ~14:50 UTC (Anza/QuickNode) vs ~15:00 (aggregators); resolved as epoch-start vs activation-in-epoch, but the 14:50 handoff is the operative mark.

- Farside row completion for Oct-19 + the Oct-20 row; October MTD ~-$669.6M floor.
